items.title: Insurance sector appointments at OAK Global, Open GI, Fortegra and Qlaims
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, firms across the UK insurance market announce senior appointments in underwriting, technology, reinsurance and claims.

items.title: LRQA acquires Hong Kong-based Omega Compliance
items.summary: According to Commercial Risk, uK-based assurance and cybersecurity provider LRQA has expanded its Asian supply chain capabilities by purchasing Omega Compliance.

items.title: UK centenarian population growth outpaces insurance care funding plans
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, official figures show the UK centenarian population has nearly doubled in twenty years, highlighting a funding gap for later-life care.

items.title: Bank of England warns climate risks could widen UK insurance gaps
items.summary: According to Reinsurance News, the central bank cautions that extreme weather could leave a growing proportion of UK mortgage borrowers without building insurance by 2050.
